name: Access Movement
operation_language: Authoring declarations only; not registered engine opcodes.

authored_operations.requirement: Use represented legal footprints, ceilings, wall heights, terrain, planes, anchoring, containment capacity, passengers/cargo and actual traveled routes. Retain source-specific movement, flight loss, squeeze/gas/stone access, safe return and blocked expulsion without overlap or telefrag. Door/container contents and unauthorized crossing remain exact identities.

blockers: Existing room placement, containment and vessel hosts are bounded; broad travel/waterborne/plane routes and every spell-specific access rule still need consumers. Fairy ring prose does not define a second map or implement return to origin.
reuse_boundary: Existing accepted pieces remain accepted at their documented limits; these requirements do not mark the entire slices missing.
